flowchart TB
  A["Ax = b"] --> LU["A = LU 분해(1회, O(n³))"]
  LU --> L1["L: 하삼각(소거 승수)"]
  LU --> U1["U: 상삼각(소거 결과)"]
  L1 --> F["전진 대입: Ly = b → y"]
  U1 --> B["후진 대입: Ux = y → x"]
  F --> B
  B --> R["새 우변 b마다 O(n²)"]
  P["부분 피벗팅: PA = LU"] -.- LU
  CH["대칭 양정치: 촐레스키"] -.- LU
lu-decomposition.pseudocode:
def lu_decompose(A):  # Doolittle, 피벗팅 생략
    n = len(A)
    L = [[1.0 if i == j else 0.0 for j in range(n)]
         for i in range(n)]
    U = [row[:] for row in A]
    for k in range(n):
        for i in range(k + 1, n):
            m = U[i][k] / U[k][k]  # 소거 승수
            L[i][k] = m
            for j in range(k, n):
                U[i][j] -= m * U[k][j]
    return L, U

def lu_solve(L, U, b):
    n = len(b)
    y = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(n):  # 전진 대입 Ly = b
        y[i] = b[i] - sum(L[i][j] * y[j] for j in range(i))
    x = [0.0] * n
    for i in reversed(range(n)):  # 후진 대입 Ux = y
        s = sum(U[i][j] * x[j] for j in range(i + 1, n))
        x[i] = (y[i] - s) / U[i][i]
    return x
